requirements.requirement: The system must define a comparison schema that includes a unique provider identifier for each provider.
The system must include provider display attributes (name, specialty, location) in the comparison schema.
The system must include an overall evaluation score per provider in the schema.
The system must include a list of individual evaluation measures per provider with measure name and score.
The system must define a relative ranking indicator per provider for each measure (e.g., higher, lower, equal).
The system must support comparison of at least two providers in a single schema payload.
The system must allow the schema to support more than two providers without structural changes.
The system must align field names and structure with the backend EVAL-COMPARE response contract.
The system must define handling for missing measure data by allowing null or placeholder values in the schema.
The system must define ordering of providers in the schema based on overall score or explicit backend order.
The system must include a normalized score field (0-100 or equivalent) for each provider if provided by backend.
The system must ensure the schema supports consistent measure keys across all providers for side-by-side comparison.
The system must define an error state schema when the backend EVAL-COMPARE response fails or is unavailable.
The system must define a loading state contract for the comparison view prior to data availability.
The system must structure the schema to allow LLM-generated explanations per provider without breaking the core contract.
The system must include a field for LLM-generated summary comparison across providers.
The system must ensure LLM-generated text fields are optional and do not block rendering if absent.
The system must constrain LLM-generated outputs to predefined schema fields and not allow arbitrary keys.
